name: Physicswallah Ltd
about: Physicswallah is an edtech company offering test preparation courses for various competitive examinations like JEE, NEET, UPSC, etc., and upskilling courses like Data science and analytics, banking and finance, software development, etc[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1][2] PhysicsWallah is one of India’s leading edtech cos offering affordable education through online, offline, and hybrid formats. The company has diversified offerings across 13 education categories, including JEE, NEET, UPSC, and new-age upskilling domains such as data science, banking and finance, and software development.
cons: Stock is trading at 8.66 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.278 Cr.

announcements.text: General Update- Press Release 23 Nov - Punjab notifies Physicswallah Digital University in Patiala; first session July 2027, marking entry into higher education.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 18 Nov - Physicswallah sets FY30 targets: ₹9,000-10,000 crore revenue, 25%+ CAGR, 20%+ EBITDA margin.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Investor Presentation 17 Nov - Physicswallah Limited has informed about Investor Presentation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 14 Nov - Physicswallah Limited has informed regarding allotment of equity shares pursuant to exercise of stock options.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 12 Nov - Physicswallah will host its first Investor Day 2026 on November 18 in Mumbai for analysts and investors.
